cohort: 26 women with MEN 1 accounting for 96 pregnancies and 76 live born infants, managed at the Royal Hobart Hospital between 1967 and 2018
finding: Maternal MEN 1 is associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders and low neonatal birthweight, but not with an increased miscarriage rate.
mod_finding: While not statistically significant, women with MEN1 had a higher rate of emergency cesarean deliveries compared to the Australian average (63.2% vs 52.3%).
